name: smwmusic-ikachan-battle-inside-water
title: Ikachan - Battle Inside Water
description:
A really energectic, and upbeat remix of a calm, and happy song from Ikachan.
Man, this one was really challenging to remix, considering how this original theme's so peaceful, to make something really tense and upbeat. However, it was really worth the result it become in the end, am happy with what I've done.

Anyway, this remix's based on both the original Mizuno, AND this early version as well, found on the early OrgView files, named as "mizu[水の中で].mid", which was where I based off the string parts, this mix's pitch, and other small things, that I worked on.
